decisions.rationale: The release record, workflow, artifact, checksum file, and independent rehash bind one exact candidate commit to one archive SHA-256.

The invalidation policy is explicit. The reviewed head directly descends from the frozen candidate and changes only release-evidence/0.1.0.json and release-evidence/artifacts/0.1.0/**; follow-up worktree changes remain within those permitted evidence-only paths.
Both required component reviews contain named, timestamped, candidate-bound acceptances. Corrected catalogue accounting is 174 determinate plus 19 cantTell examples, 193 total.

limitations: Acceptance applies only if the corrected component records and follow-up evidence-only changes are committed unchanged within the permitted paths.
RG-22, readiness, merge, and publication remain pending.
